headline: India box office: Ramayana leads the latest daily chart at ₹107.5 Cr
lede: Ramayana leads the latest reported daily India nett at ₹107.5 Cr on Day 5, taking cumulative India nett to ₹453.9 Cr and worldwide gross to ₹673.9 Cr on the Indian Box Office consensus desk.
body:
Good morning. This is the Indian Box Office morning brief for 2026-11-10 (IST desk date), written from the verified consensus board rather than any single trade headline. India still has no official theatrical auditor; every rupee figure below is a desk estimate, labelled so India nett is never confused with worldwide gross.

## Daily chart leader

Ramayana sits at the top of the latest-day India nett ranking with ₹107.5 Cr on Day 5. Cumulative India nett is ₹453.9 Cr; worldwide gross on this desk is ₹673.9 Cr. The title is filed as Indian and currently carries a working status of playing with verdict Pending.

Scene is next on the daily chart at ₹21.4 Cr (Day 4, cumulative India nett ₹106 Cr), with Mookuthi Amman 2 third at ₹5.2 Cr. Gaps between the top three matter more than the order alone: a soft midweek day for a long-runner can look “small” in absolute crores while still being a healthy hold for its week of release.

## Holds, momentum, and lifetime context

Since the previous board snapshot, notable lifetime moves include: Ramayana +10 Cr worldwide; Scene +2.5 Cr worldwide; Karuppu -2.4 Cr worldwide; India nett -30.8 Cr; Udta Teer -2.1 Cr worldwide. Treat snapshot-to-snapshot deltas as orientation — ingest repairs and late reports can restate a total without meaning the film “earned” that swing in a single calendar day.

Lifetime context: Dhurandhar: The Revenge remains the cumulative worldwide leader on this board at ₹1,820 Cr (India nett ₹1,108.1 Cr). That is a career-to-date total, not today’s daily chart.

## Language circuits

Across the top of the daily chart, circuit mix looks like this — Indian: 10 titles contributing about ₹138.4 Cr of latest-day India nett among the top tracked films; Hindi: 1 title contributing about ₹0.2 Cr of latest-day India nett among the top tracked films; English: 1 title contributing about ₹0.2 Cr of latest-day India nett among the top tracked films. Hindi, South Indian, and Hollywood titles can share the same national chart while living on very different screen footprints; compare like with like when judging a Day 8 versus a Day 1.

## How to read today’s brief

Use the home board for the live “this week” stack, open individual film pages for the full day-wise table and analysis, and keep this brief as the morning narrative layer. Definitions: India nett is domestic after entertainment tax/GST; worldwide gross is global ticket revenue before those deductions. Methodology and corrections live on the desk’s public policy pages.
